name: registro-actopan
description: Registro híbrido y validación QR de un solo uso para evento en Actopan, Hidalgo.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:https --prefix client"
